description: Cache academic HTML using origin freshness; keep the language entry point uncached
expression: http.host eq "academic.davidz.cn" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path ne "/" and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".html")) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/oauth/")
